name: limit-nesting-depth-at-limit
description: A definition nested to exactly the maximum depth of 5 -- slots array, slot object, binding object, and the binding's set array -- parses and canonicalises normally: the nesting cap does not fire at the boundary itself.
notes: Depth is counted with the root object itself as depth 1, so the deepest legal path here is root -> slots array -> slot object -> binding object -> refs array = 5. Built as the suite's minimal fixture with its value binding widened to a two-member set purely to reach the fifth container level. Delivered as input_bytes rather than input because nesting depth is a structural parse limit: the vector must begin at the strict parse stage, on raw bytes, to prove the byte parser itself accepts input at the boundary, not merely that already-parsed JSON at this depth passes schema validation.
